headline: Oil near US$118, a Bank of Canada hike and a $16.9B Ontario deficit defined the week
summary: Brent crude climbed about 15% in October as tankers were hit near Hormuz, and the Bank of Canada raised rates while Statistics Canada reported the economy stalled in August. Ontario's fall update lifted the deficit to $16.9 billion, new U.S. tariffs took effect, and the U.S. midterms are Tuesday.

top.headline: Brent tops US$117 as two more tankers are hit near Hormuz
top.what: Oil posted its fourth straight monthly gain on Friday after two tankers were damaged in the Strait of Hormuz within a day and Washington kept the option of new strikes on Iran open.
top.why: In the briefing on 3 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: New U.S. tariff list takes effect as Ottawa reports little progress
top.what: A reshuffled list of Canadian goods facing 50% U.S. tariffs took effect Friday, while a Canadian official said talks on steel and auto duties have made only limited progress.
top.why: In the briefing on 3 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Economy stalls in August, two days after Bank of Canada's hike
top.what: Statistics Canada says the economy was flat in August and probably shrank 0.1% in September, a weak backdrop for the Bank of Canada's first rate increase since 2023.
top.why: In the briefing on 3 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Chow re-elected; GTA voters oust mayors in Mississauga, Hamilton, Oakville and Milton
top.what: Olivia Chow won a second term as Toronto mayor, and final counts show voters across the region replaced several long-serving incumbents.
top.why: In the briefing on 3 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Senate control a toss-up as midterms enter final weekend
top.what: With Election Day on Tuesday, forecasters see control of the U.S. Senate hinging on about six states, and both parties are pouring in late money.
top.why: In the briefing on 3 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Ontario deficit grows to $16.9 billion; balance pushed to 2029-30
top.what: Finance Minister Peter Bethlenfalvy's fall update raised this year's deficit by more than $3 billion and delayed a balanced budget by a year as the trade war slows growth.
top.why: In the briefing on 3 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: U.S. approves 500 Patriot missiles for Ukraine as Russia keeps up strikes
top.what: Washington cleared the sale of 500 Patriot air-defence missiles to Kyiv as Russia fired more than 100 drones and several missiles overnight, while Moscow signalled no change in its war aims.
top.why: In the briefing on 3 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Police seek suspects after violent Bridle Path home invasion; family asks for privacy
top.what: A Toronto real estate company CEO and his two adult daughters were shot, and the family was beaten, in a home invasion early Thursday. Police are still looking for suspects.
top.why: A rare, violent attack in one of Toronto's wealthiest neighbourhoods that is drawing national attention.
